text.en:
Get a Quote — Hanbros UK

Use this page to get a quote with Hanbros UK, the leading United Kingdom to Turkey shipping specialist. Our bilingual team supports cargo, parcels, household removals and vehicle consignments with transparent pricing and full customs handling.

Complete the form or follow the on-page instructions — we respond within one working day with next steps, collection options and a clear quote.

Hanbros UK — trusted UK–Turkey logistics from enquiry to delivery.
